title: 小鹏顾宏地：人形机器人IRON亮相，凭何定义“最像人”？
speaker: Brian Gu

segments.en: Iron is set to begin training as a store assistant in X-Pong retail outlets in the first quarter of next year with a public release targeted for the second quarter. Joining us exclusively now is Brian Goo, Vice Chairman and President at X-Pong.
segments.zh: Iron将于明年第一季度在小鹏零售门店开始作为店员培训，计划第二季度公开发布。小鹏副董事长兼总裁顾宏地独家加入我们。

segments.en: Brian, it's always great to have you on the program. Talk a little bit more about iron, right?
segments.zh: 顾宏地，很高兴你再次做客节目。再谈谈Iron吧？

segments.en: I mean, we've seen so many Chinese companies including Tesla come out with their own version of humanoid robots.
segments.zh: 我们看到许多中国公司，包括特斯拉，都推出了自己的人形机器人。

segments.en: What sets iron apart? Well, we're happy to be back in the show.
segments.zh: Iron有何独特之处？很高兴回到节目。

segments.en: Yes, iron is actually our humanoid robot.
segments.zh: 是的，Iron实际上是我们的类人机器人。

segments.en: This is actually the second year we have debuted at iron in our tech day.
segments.zh: 这实际上是我们第二年在我们科技日上推出Iron。

segments.en: It is actually a very different, I would say, a product compared to the other human robots on the market.
segments.zh: 与市场上其他类人机器人相比，它实际上是一个非常不同的产品。

segments.en: One, it's actually, I would call it the most human-like human robot.
segments.zh: 第一，我称之为最像人的类人机器人。

segments.en: It is actually a robot that has a human size, human figure, human posture, as well as human intelligence.
segments.zh: 它实际上是一个具有人类尺寸、人类外形、人类姿态以及人类智能的机器人。

segments.en: It's a robot that we aim to deliver a deploy in what we call the human commercial environment.
segments.zh: 我们的目标是在我们所说的人类商业环境中交付和部署这款机器人。

segments.en: You mentioned that deployment schedule is for internal scenarios next year.
segments.zh: 你提到明年的部署计划是针对内部场景。

segments.en: And then also the first half will be, I was saying, our internal stores, as well as maybe offices and other as a tour guide.
segments.zh: 上半年会是我们内部门店，可能还有办公室等作为导览。

segments.en: And then the second half, we aim to look at, you know, export external delivery as well.
segments.zh: 下半年，我们计划看向外部交付。

segments.en: What I also want to say is that this is also a robot that we aim to do general common purpose task.
segments.zh: 我还想说的是，这也是我们旨在完成通用任务的机器人。

segments.en: It's not aimed to just, you know, do one task.
segments.zh: 它不是只为了做单一任务。

segments.en: So we actually have a training process utilizing our own self-developed AI chip, the touring as well as the AI infrastructure data training infrastructure that actually can let the robot learn new skills and also be deploying to different scenarios.
segments.zh: 所以我们有一个训练流程，利用自研AI芯片、图灵平台以及AI数据训练基础设施，让机器人学习新技能并部署到不同场景。
